editorial:
Imagine being trapped in a cold, foggy forest with enemies closing in from every side. You are part of a small group of Croatian soldiers in 1993 who think they are just fighting a normal war, but things quickly get weird. You start seeing ghosts and strange figures from the past that shouldn't be there. The vibe is heavy and spooky, mixing a gritty war story with a supernatural mystery that makes you feel like the land itself is trying to tell you something dark about what happened decades ago.

The acting feels real, and the way the movie jumps between the 1940s and the 1990s keeps you guessing. While some parts move a bit slow, the tension builds up nicely until the big reveal. If you like movies that blend history with horror, you will really enjoy this one. To get the best experience, you should look for the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality, or see if you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: You find out that the ghosts are actually soldiers from a pro-Nazi group from fifty years ago. The current soldiers are stuck in a loop of violence and pain. The ending shows that the hatred from the past is still alive in the soil. Most of the squad doesn't make it out, as the supernatural forces and the real war combine to wipe them out, proving that history repeats itself in a brutal way.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves war movies with a supernatural twist.
